notes: A fully self-contained browser-based 3D exploration experience featuring a procedurally generated floating island with a 7-tier pagoda built with authentic architectural details (dougong brackets, hip roofs with chiwen ornaments, balustrades, lanterns, interior floors and stairs). The island features stratified geology with cliff strata, moss, roots, and vegetation that follows terrain normals. Living systems include 6 waterfalls with particle simulation and splash effects, 4 drifting cloud layers with sun lighting, dynamic mist that reacts to height and time, and a full day/night cycle with directional sun/moon, god rays, bloom, and emissive lanterns. Player can walk, sprint, jump, glide, and explore with full collision detection against all geometry. 12 shrines with lanterns to light, 8 collectible offerings, 5 ringable bells with physics-simulated clappers, and a meditation point at the pagoda summit that shifts time. Synthesized ambient audio via Web Audio API: wind, water, creaking wood, bell tones, bird calls, and footstep sounds with spatial positioning. Runs from a single index.html with no build step, uses Three.js via importmap from CDN, all assets generated procedurally at runtime. Tested to open cold with no console errors.
